marketplaces.name: objkt
marketplaces.notes: Current official objkt FAQ explicitly states no geographic restrictions on minting, listing, selling, or receiving proceeds. External wallet providers, payment/on-ramp services and exchanges retain their own country restrictions. Check applicable law and the provider terms before any transaction.

marketplaces.name: OpenSea
marketplaces.notes: Do not use unless current terms and the creator's actual legal circumstances confirm eligibility. Never bypass geographic, identity, or sanctions controls.
